name: Mack Greenlaw-Scully
description: I am a computer science student at Penn State University. I love to make things, so I made this webpage to highlight some of my favorite things that I've made.

currentProjects.title: Cat Game (Godot)
currentProjects.description: A lighthearted video game that I am developing in Godot for my lovely girlfriend as a gift.

highlightedProjects.title: Handwritten Digit Classifier (Java)
highlightedProjects.description: A handwritten neural network that can classify the MNIST handwritten digit training set with 96 percent accuracy after 10 training epochs. My implementation of the neural network is inspired by a course I am currently taking on the Mathematics of Deep Learning.

highlightedProjects.title: Chess Engine/Bot (C)
highlightedProjects.description: A chess engine/bot written in C by me and my lovely girlfriend. It uses no external libraries except for GUI. We implemented the logic for a fully-functioning chess engine from scratch and a bot that plays at ~1000 chess.com ELO with alpha-beta tree search and a static evaluation function.

highlightedProjects.title: Rust Text Editor
highlightedProjects.description: A terminal-based text editor written in Rust. Supports creating/editing UTF-8 encoded text files in the terminal (Windows or Linux). Extra features include ctrl+s saving, vertical window scrolling, and a working selection window (as you would expect ctrl+arrow or shift+arrow to function in a text editor).

highlightedProjects.title: 2D Game Engine (Java)
highlightedProjects.description: The first big project I made: a game engine written in Java. Using no external packages, I wrote a tiny 2D RPG game engine with AABB physics, an animation interface, timers, a level editor, and more.
